contexts.text: That everything is possible to Jehovah. Signified.
The love of self... grows to every degree of given possibility...
That this is not possible. Signified, Explained.

The reason it is not possible because it is not from order, is that in the other life all is possible which is from order. The Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord is what makes order... hence everything according to Divine truth... is possible. Example(s).
Hence it is not possible for the evil and good to be together. Nor is it possible for the evil to be in good... Hence it is evident that it is not possible for those in Hell to be saved...
